data.name: Mufadhal
data.gender_notes: Mufadhal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name, Mufadhal, is derived from the Arabic root 'fdl', which means 'to strive' or 'to struggle'. In the context of Islamic history and spirituality, this name holds great significance. It is a reminder of the struggle and perseverance required in the faith and in life. The name Mufadhal carries the meaning “Struggling, Striving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mufadhal usually hope their child will grow to embody struggling, striving and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mufadhal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Struggling, Striving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mufadhal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Historically, the name has been used to signify someone who is highly regarded or esteemed in the eyes of God.
